parameters.content:
## Audiobook TTS (OpenAI)
1) Add your full book/chapter text in **Set audiobook text and settings**.
2) Keep `gpt-4o-mini-tts` for lowest OpenAI cost (often usable with trial credits).
3) Execute workflow.
4) MP3 parts are written to `/tmp` as `your-title-part-01.mp3`, `part-02.mp3`, etc.
